label: Scot's Physiognomy
summary: Michael Scot on physiognomy, the reading of character from outward appearance.

value.text: no. 117, Medicine, Anatomy, Astrology and Miscellany

claims.statement: Entered as no. 117 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Medicine, Anatomy, Astrology and Miscellany. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "the physiognomy of Scotus".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Liber physiognomiae. The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
Composition and printing as given in the reconstruction: Composed c. 1230 · Printed 1477.
